response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(spatial_count) AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count) AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT source, spatial_count AS count, CAST(spatial_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share, spatial_count - average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE spatial_count > average_count ORDER BY spatial_count DESC, source;

assumptions.assumption: Coverage means the number of matched spatial records per funding source; sources without a funding value are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Coverage means the number of distinct projects with spatial data per funding source.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count, AVG(project_count) AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT source, project_count AS count, CAST(project_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share, project_count - average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE project_count > average_count ORDER BY project_count DESC, source;
